g.text: Share and be found (REQ-005-8/9)
Who is asking?
a visitor on a listing's public page
a search engine or a chat app reading a page
Taps "Share"
yes
The phone has a share sheet?
Open it with the listing's title and address.
A sheet that is closed again does nothing
yes
The address can be copied?
no
Copy the address and say "Link copied"
Write the address out beside the button,
to be copied by hand
A friend receives the link. The chat app
shows a preview: the title and business name,
then the salary range, area and region
The friend follows the link and sees the
public page with no account (REQ-005-5)
Which page?
Own page title: job title, business, region.
Description: salary range, type, area and region.
Job details a search engine can read: title, business,
area and region, salary range in PHP per month,
type, date posted (the approval), the text.
No closing date: listings do not expire
Own page title: "Jobs in Davao City | jairojobs"
for a region, "Jobs in the Philippines, with the
salary shown | jairojobs" for the home page.
Description: one plain sentence
A hidden region's listings are
treated like any others.
Asks not to be listed in search results
Answered as "gone", so it is dropped
Behind log-in, and never in the sitemap
Every public page states its one address, and is
complete as first delivered: its text does not
wait for scripts to run
No third-party script, tag or tracker
is added for any of this.
The sitemap lists the home page, each active
region's jobs and each Published listing,
and nothing else
a Published listing
a private page: Admin area,
My listings, Settings
the home page or
a region's jobs
a list with search
words or a type, or
a hidden region's list
a closed or taken
down listing
